$comment: Active structural schema used by records.py. The legacy filename is retained for compatibility. Exact source, cross-reference, arithmetic, vocabulary and scientific checks are separately required. Structural validity is not scientific acceptance. Optional source-local documentary correspondence extension v1.0 (2026-10-23); no lexical identity, no implicit aggregation.

occurrence.$comment: Source-local occurrence/iteration ordinal with exact evidence. It is not an amount, duration or year number. The author supplies the interpretation; absent means no ordinal asserted.

item_attributes.$comment: Compact anchored attributes are keyed by fixed field names. Targets use item ID plus /attributes/<key>/value. Grade/age_class accept lexical atf: values or positive ordinal strings; a class ordinal is not an inferred number of age-years.

json_value.$comment: Candidate is checked against its actual target field type by the cross-reference validator; JSON Schema alone cannot resolve the record_id/field pair.

lexical_code.$comment: Interpreted code must resolve in the exact versioned semantic/unit/standard vocabulary. Pattern validation alone cannot authorize a new meaning. The registry dependency must be fixed before live adoption.

geometric_axis.description: Optional source-supported geometric role; function remains amount and dimension remains length when established.

native_standard.$comment: Exact written standard designation only. Does not assert metrological equivalence, a conversion factor or a link to an interpreted standard.

native_term_id.$comment: Generate from exact selected evidence-token pieces joined with ASCII space; UTF-8 percent encoding is canonical only after decode/re-encode equality. No semantic equivalence or arithmetic meaning follows.

rational.$comment: Fraction reduction/gcd=1 requires a separate exact arithmetic check.

field.$comment: Pointer must resolve through object fields only; no array traversal or immutable/raw replacement targets. Check against actual referenced record.
